title: Arterm's own version line
highlights: MCP servers end to end: add, list and remove them from the CLI, and see them live in an interactive /mcp panel
Telemetry, tool discovery and self-update are now off unless you turn them on, and commands arterm runs are no longer handed your API keys
Sign in to xAI with a Grok subscription, with no API key
improvements: There is finally a working way to install arterm: a documented install command, a Homebrew tap and npm packages that are actually ours
/config edits the display settings on screen, and can turn on the live sessions manager
Logging in with an OpenAI-compatible provider now counts as being logged in
Starting arterm no longer rebinds your desktop's global shortcuts unless you ask it to
The onboarding screens describe what telemetry actually sends
The startup screen says where you left off, and a startup notice no longer reads as part of the conversation
Internal reliability work: the test suite runs to completion again
fixes: A provider that recommends a replacement model after a 404 is now followed exactly, instead of falling back to an older one
Onboarding no longer returns to the login screen when the only configured provider is an OpenAI-compatible one
Centered mode stays centered when the window shrinks, and leaves nothing behind in the corner
A terminal's late colour reply is no longer treated as something you typed
The URLs, packages and --help text no longer point at repositories and names that are not ours
